name: Aiden Lee
tagline: Industrial & Operations Engineering student at Michigan. I find slow, manual work and build software that compresses it.
bio:
I'm a junior studying Industrial & Operations Engineering at the [University of Michigan](https://ioe.engin.umich.edu/). I moved from Seoul to Toronto when I was six, played on Korea's youth national hockey team, started college and research in Chicago, then served 18 months as a logistics officer and interpreter in the Korean Army. [Read the longer story](journey/index.html).

Since then I've kept doing one thing: find a slow, manual piece of knowledge work and build a tool that makes it fast. At GLG Korea that was a [value-chain research tool](posts/value-chain-explorer.html) for the business development team. With friends it's [Apeul](https://apeul.com), a study companion for college courses.

Every week my dad sends me a report on the world economy, and every trading day a short market note. Talking those through with him is how I learn to see the world. I write down what I take from it in [Worldview](worldview/index.html).
now:
- Researching *learning to defer* with Prof. Wentao Weng at U-M IOE: when should an AI decide on its own, and when should it hand a task to a human expert with limited capacity?
- Looking for a Summer 2027 role at an early-stage AI startup, working on growth and go-to-market.
- Building Apeul with my team, and small tools for myself, like a job agent that reads application portals so I don't have to.
- Going back to fundamentals: math, philosophy, psychology.
worldviewBlurb: Notes from my weekly and daily conversations with my dad about the economy, markets and geopolitics. The full archive lives in [Tinkerly](https://tinkering-weekly.vercel.app).

projects.name: Value Chain Explorer
projects.description: Type a company name and get its value chain, impact-scored news pinned to each link, and the experts to call about each signal. English and Korean. Built solo at GLG Korea, 2026. [Write-up](posts/value-chain-explorer.html).

projects.name: Apeul
projects.description: Your A+ course companion: lecture slides become notes, cheat sheets and practice questions, with an AI tutor in context. Built with my team. [Write-up](posts/apeul.html).

projects.name: Hypothesis CDD Predictor
projects.description: A Flask + Claude app that drafts a MECE hypothesis tree for commercial due diligence. Open source. [Write-up](posts/cdd-predictor.html).

projects.name: Job Agent 27
projects.description: My personal Summer 2027 job agent. Three times a day it pulls new postings from LinkedIn and Jobright, drops reposts, reads each real application page for work-authorization language, and sends me a digest. The dashboard updates three times a day.

projects.name: Tinkerly
projects.description: A newspaper I built from my dad's weekly world reports and daily market notes: a front page, a timeline and map of how the world changed, and an analyst agent that writes down forecasts and scores them. My own takeaways live in [Worldview](worldview/index.html).

projects.name: S&P 500 Top 20 Dashboard
projects.description: DCF, DDM and multiples for the twenty largest S&P 500 names, with a Monte Carlo risk model. [Notebook](posts/sp500-analysis-notebook.html).

projects.name: Gold Monte Carlo
projects.description: Simulating gold price paths, then adjusting them for Fed policy. Notebooks: [baseline](posts/gold-monte-carlo-notebook.html), [Fed-adjusted](posts/gold-fed-monte-carlo-notebook.html). Plus a live [gold price tracker](posts/gold-price-tracker.html).
